ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, point $D$ is a point on segment $CB$, and point $E$ is the midpoint of segment $DB$. Given that $AB=20$ and $EB=3$, what is the length of segment $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point C is the midpoint of line segment AB,\\
it follows that $CB=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{2}\times 20=10$\\
Given that $CD=CB-DB$,\\
it then results in $CD=10-6=\boxed{4}$
